title: Falsy-zero bug: width=0, height=0, size=0 silently ignored
description: Lines 270-273 (pane_resize), 173-176 (sessions_create), and 254-255 (pane_split) use `if body.width:` guards that treat 0 as falsy. If a caller passes width=0 or height=0, the value is silently dropped instead of being passed to libtmux. While unusual, 0 is a valid dimension request that should either be honored or explicitly rejected with a 400.
